title: LearnHub
summary: A Moodle LMS (LearnHub) on MariaDB, both Bitnami images: a stored-XSS profile/forum field that keeps user HTML, IDOR on the ?id=/?userid= user and resource endpoints, and a MariaDB holding student PII plus bcrypt ($2y$) password hashes a DB dump exfiltrates directly.

loot.description: student billing/contact PII (names + emails) dumped straight from mdl_user
Moodle account password hashes — bcrypt ($2y$ prefix), proving credential material is present in the DB
the LearnHub front page's generator/footer string, proving the Moodle LMS is up and fingerprintable
